products.label: MCXC-II, CDS J/A+A/688/A187, 2024-11-29
products.process: Select seven MCXC-II identifiers; place each at the distance of its Cosmicflows-4 group (the group of its brightest galaxy); integrate the redshifts in the declared flat cosmology only to check the catalogue's angular scale.
limitations: Each centre is the X-ray position at its group's averaged distance; no cluster boundary is claimed, and R500 is an analysis aperture.
